title: 402 Nueva Street

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located in the Central Business District at the southwest corner of the intersection of W. Nueva St. and Urban Loop and it also abuts IH 10 (elevated).

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility, and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: D, Downtown, City of San Antonio
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: The Federal Emergency Management Agency maps do not appear to indicate any floodplain on the site.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: Most recent (2024) Texas State Highway Department traffic count map indicates 175,759 vehicles per day on IH 10, just northwest of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2026.

rows.label: Potential Use
rows.text: Site would be appropriate for a variety of commercial, residential, or hospitality uses typical in downtown.

qa_notes: Title: the cover prints '402 NUEVA STREET' (no 'W.'); the Demographic Overview heads it '402 W. NUEVA STREET', the Location row says 'W. Nueva St.', and Prismic's title is '402 W. Nueva Street'. Transcribed the cover as printed.

Variant: set to 'land' because the package markets a 'Redevelopment Site' sized in acres only, but the close aerial (p6) shows existing buildings and parking on the site. No building size is given anywhere.
Transaction: the PDF never says 'For Sale' or 'For Lease'; set 'For Sale' from context ('Prospective buyers'). Verify.
Comment 3 typo: 'United State Federal Courthouse' (should be 'United States'); Prismic highlight already reads 'United States'. Transcribed as printed.
Zoning: PDF 'D, Downtown, City of San Antonio'; Prismic 'D (Downtown), City of San Antonio' (same zoning, punctuation differs).
Size: PDF '2.696 +/- acres'; Prismic size_label '2.696 acres' (match). Aerial map headers leave the acreage blank ('Texas, AC +/-'). The cover has no size line.
Spec-page demographics (13,341 / 140,473 / 360,124; $27,386 / $44,634 / $49,950) match the Demographic Overview page.

This package uses a different, newer demographics layout than the other Roalson packages: 2026 ESRI data (date April 28, 2026), Median (not Average) Household Income, and sections for Age, Median Home Value/Rent and Education & Employment. There is no 2020 Census or 5 Year Projection row, and no Race/Ethnicity or income-bracket sections.

Demographic Overview structure: 'Median Household Income' sits alone after a gap at the bottom with no section heading; stored as a section with heading ''. The 'Households' section holds a 'Total Housing Units' row while the next heading is also '2026 Total Housing Units'. Owner- plus Renter-Occupied do not sum to 100% (79% / 85% / 88%, presumably vacant units excluded) - as printed.
Traffic Count cites the 'Texas State Highway Department' (obsolete agency name); transcribed as printed.
Disclosure page (p8) gives an old broker address: 'BUILDING 2, SUITE 206 / 2338 NORTH LOOP 1604 W. / SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS 78248' (the other packages show 17721 Rogers Ranch Pkwy., Suite 125, 78258).

Layout leftovers: hidden 'Area Map' (p5) and 'Survey' (p6) captions sit behind the aerial images, suggesting a survey page was dropped from an earlier version; there is no survey in this package. Pages 5-6 also carry a rotated duplicate of the footer disclaimer in the right margin.
Utilities are labelled 'Electric' (not 'Electricity') and ordered Electric, Water, Sewer, Gas.
